metadata.title: A graphically based machine learning approach to predict secondary schools performance in Tunisia

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used average plausible values for analysis, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Matching text-readable full PDF has no explicit statement that ILSA sampling weights were omitted; weight references concern model parameters, outcome scaling, data variables or class/pixel weighting, not demonstrated sample-weight use.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes data at the school level but does not use multilevel modeling or account for school clustering in its analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions using bootstrap methods for internal validation, indicating that it did not validate findings on an external dataset.
design_fields._pdf_matched: 120. Rebai et al. (2020). A Graphically Based Machine Learning Approach to Predict Secondary Schools' Performance in Tunisia.pdf
design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): “based on a sample of Tunisian secondary schools… In the first stage… In the second stage we apply machine-learning approaches… to identify… variables that are associated with a high school performance.”
design_fields._q2_audit: Source checked; original extraction rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not apply sampling weights in the analysis.
